verdicts.evidence: lines 601-644: all 11 buttons (check, retry, import, edit, 2 downloads, show more, stop, resume, import more, fix rows) have listeners that do what the label names; edit-btn goes back via history/popstate (617-619, 646-653).

lines 404-435, 468-490: rows come from the parsed CSV and problems from api.validateImport; counts are computed from those lists; progress from runImport callbacks (517-521). No hardcoded sample values or placeholder text.

lines 441-466: review step shows counts, the skipped-rows note and the row table beside the Import button; lines 499-502, 540-549: run step shows N of M imported and how many problem rows were skipped.

lines 268-271, 604-605, 658: textarea draft is written to sessionStorage on input and restored on load; 415-422 failed check leaves the text; 646-653 Back returns to edit with text, Forward restores review if unchanged; 550-552 failed import keeps remaining rows.

line 136, 601: the form default action is Check contacts, which imports nothing; line 435: default filter is rows with problems; 386, 438: after check focus goes to the heading, not Import. No dialogs.
lines 117-196, 380-387: add, check and import run as three in-page steps with no dialogs; choosing a file starts the check itself (597); the review step is the pre-import check the brief asks for.

lines 117-196: file and paste inputs, problem table with filter, import with progress, stop and outcome all map to the brief; download and fix-rows buttons (147, 191-192) act on the problem rows and outcome. No stat cards, tips or unrelated panels.
line 136: one primary in edit view; 145, 455-457: edit-btn becomes primary only when import-btn is hidden; 189-190, 554-556: resume-btn and new-btn are both primary but mutually exclusive via hidden.
No action deletes or overwrites stored records: import adds contacts (493-531), stop keeps imported rows and is resumable (631-638), the other buttons navigate or download.

lines 409, 421, 634: aria-disabled is set only on the check and stop buttons while their own request is in flight (exception); unusable controls are hidden instead (455, 458, 460, 554-560) with the reason in the note (447-448).
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or script (lines 109-199, 245-661).
lines 110-193 and all strings in 310-332, 366-377, 416, 444-463, 540-561: text is only about contacts, rows and the import; no mention of implementation, mock data or the request.

line 127: format hint sits at the textarea; 447-452: 'N rows have problems and will be skipped' sits above the Import button it informs; 416: 'Nothing has been imported' in the failure notice beside Try again. No other notices.

lines 121-136: labels and one hint line only; 448: 'Fix the rows in your spreadsheet, or edit the contacts here' is next-step guidance beside Edit contacts, not narration of the screen. No 'use the form below' text.

lines 126-127: hint adds the column rule, does not restate the label; 444-452: heading gives importable count, note gives skipped count; 545-548: outcome body adds where saved rows are and how many remain. h2 'Add contacts' is screen-reader only (118).
All visible strings (110-193, 310-332, 366-377, 416, 444-463, 540-561) are factual; no greetings, slogans, exclamation marks or congratulations. Success reads 'N contacts imported' (540).

Labels: Check contacts (136), Try again (133), Import N contacts (456), Edit contacts (146), Download the N rows with problems (459), Show N more (489), Stop import (183), Import the remaining N (555), Import more contacts (190), Fix the N skipped rows (558).

lines 366-377: server codes REQUIRED, EMAIL_FORMAT, PHONE_FORMAT, DUPLICATE_IN_CRM, ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT are mapped to plain sentences with a plain fallback; column headers are Row, Name, Email, Phone, Company, Check (160-165).

line 416: 'The contacts could not be checked. The connection to the server dropped. Nothing has been imported.' with Try again; 545-555: interrupted import states reason, saved and remaining counts with a resume button; 319, 329, 584: parse errors say what to change.

lines 310-332, 366-377, 416, 545-549, 584-593: wording such as 'is missing', 'is not a valid address', 'could not be checked', 'Import interrupted'; no 'invalid', 'failed', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals; subject is the data or server.
lines 310, 332, 403: zero contacts is rejected at the textarea before the review view opens; 460, 469: the filter exists only when both good and bad rows exist, so the table can never have zero rows.

lines 403-405, 460, 469: the review table cannot be empty for any reason (empty input is a field error, filters only offered when both groups are non-empty); a failed check shows its own notice with retry (416-417).

lines 415-422: failed check shows a notice above the button with Try again and the textarea keeps its text; 526-530, 545-555: failed import states it, keeps the remaining rows in pending and the textarea, and offers 'Import the remaining N'.

lines 408-411: check button shows spinner and 'Checking N rows...' at once; 180-183, 499-502, 517-521: import shows a progress bar, 'N of M contacts imported' and a Stop import button wired to AbortController (631-637).
The page has no empty state (see STATE-001); during the check the edit view stays with a busy button (408-411) and the review view is rendered only after the response (431-438).

lines 79-81: fixed table layout with overflow-wrap anywhere; 251, 470, 486-489: 100 rows at a time with Show more; 333, 476: missing cells render as empty string or 'missing', never undefined; 263: numbers via toLocaleString; 63: actions wrap.
lines 604-605, 594: every textarea change and file load is written to sessionStorage and restored at 658 on return or reload; 654: beforeunload prompts while an import is running.

line 127: 'First line: name, email, phone, company. Name and email are required.' is visible under the label before input; label 121 says CSV file. The 5 MB cap (586) is shown only on error but is far beyond the brief's few hundred rows.

lines 121, 126: the two inputs are worded as alternatives ('Choose a CSV file' / 'Or paste CSV text'); 127: 'Name and email are required' states column status in words; empty submit explains what is needed (403).
lines 400-405, 601: validation runs only on submit (or after a file is chosen); 604-607: the input handler only clears an existing error and never raises one while typing.

lines 582-593: file errors (wrong type, too large, unreadable) are written to #csv-error, which sits under the textarea (129), and set aria-invalid and the red border on the textarea, not beside the file field (121-123) they concern. Textarea errors are adjacent (389-392).

lines 403-405: client rejection returns without touching the textarea; 415-422: server rejection only restores the button and unlocks the textarea; text stays in place and in sessionStorage. Rejected file leaves existing text untouched (582-593).

lines 389-392: textarea errors focus the textarea with aria-invalid and aria-describedby csv-error (128). But file errors (582) focus the file input, which has no aria-invalid and is described only by file-status (122); csv-error has no live role, so the message is not tied to it.

line 136: submit has no disabled attribute; 409, 421: aria-disabled only while the check request is in flight; 403: submitting empty shows 'Paste CSV text or choose a CSV file.' and focuses the textarea.

lines 401, 408-410: 'checking' flag returns early on a second submit and the button shows a busy label; 494, 505-506: 'importing' flag guards both Import and resume, and the view switches to progress at once.

lines 409-410: check button turns busy synchronously; 508-513: Import switches to the progress view before awaiting; 634-635: Stop turns into 'Stopping...'; 622, 626: filter and show-more re-render immediately.
lines 441-454: check result is stated in the review heading; 539-549: import outcome heading states imported, stopped or interrupted with counts; 416-417: check failure stated in a notice.

No success toast, banner or dialog. The import result is the outcome heading itself (540); 'Loaded <file>' (595) is an inline status line naming the file, which is not otherwise shown since the input is cleared (603).

lines 131-134, 416-417: check failure is an in-place notice cleared only by the next check (393-397); 129, 606: field error stays until the user edits; 553-562: import failure is a persistent outcome panel. No timers dismiss messages.

lines 631-637: Stop import runs at once with no confirmation, and 554-555, 638 offer 'Import the remaining N' to carry on; 617-619: Edit contacts returns without a prompt and Forward restores the review (649).
No action permanently deletes or overwrites records, sends an unrecallable message or spends money; import adds contacts after a review step that names counts and skipped rows (441-456).
line 654: the only confirmation is the browser's leave prompt, raised only while an import is running; no confirmation on check, edit, stop, download or filter.
No optimistic updates: review renders only after validateImport resolves (414-438) and progress shows only counts reported by the server callback (517-521).
No modal dialogs; the three views are page sections toggled by setView (380-387).
No modal dialogs in markup or script (109-199, 245-661).

lines 110-138: edit view is title, step list, then the file and paste fields and Check button; 141-173: review opens with the result heading, actions and the problem rows first (filter defaults to 'bad', 435).
lines 110-123: h1 'Import contacts', a one-line step list, then the first input. No hero, greeting or introductory panel.
lines 444-463: counts shown are importable rows, rows with problems and totals, which drive the go-ahead decision; 501: progress count; 540-549: outcome counts. No decorative metrics or charts.
lines 149-154, 461-464: the active filter is a visible radio group labelled with counts directly above the table, 'All (N)' clears it in one action; 487: 'Showing X of Y rows' gives the result count.

lines 121-193: every control is a native button, radio, file input or textarea; busy buttons use aria-disabled so stay focusable (409, 634); focus is moved to headings or the next row on view changes (386, 564, 627-628). Drag and drop has the file input as alternative.

line 66: errors carry a 'Problem: ' text prefix; 476, 482-484: problem rows have 'missing' text and a Check column reading the problem or 'Ready'; 36, 384: current step is bold, underlined and aria-current.

line 198: #live role=status exists on load and is filled by announce() for checking, progress quarters, outcome and filter counts (266, 411, 520, 563, 623); 131: failure notice is a pre-existing role=alert; 123: file status is role=status.
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs; Show more appends rows (625-629) and the filter is a native radio group.

lines 94-105: under 680px the table becomes stacked label and value blocks via data-label, action buttons go full width, padding shrinks; 35, 63, 74: step list, actions and filter wrap; 48: file input max-width 100%. No fixed widths wider than the screen.
